docs.title: ansipath 🌈
docs.text: ansipath makes PATH legible with a portable Go binary, colorized output, palettes, and shell helpers.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text: Build with go build -trimpath -o ansipath . and run ansipath install. sudo ansipath install targets SUDO_USER shell files and installs under /usr/bin.

docs.title: Usage
docs.text: ansipath, ansipath --help, ansipath palette list, ansipath palette NAME, and ansipath remove-dupes.

docs.title: Ansipath installation
docs.text: Install the Go binary under HOME/.local/bin, helpers under HOME/.local/share/ansipath/shell_helpers, and palette state under HOME/.local/state/ansipath.
